image_description: A close-up photograph of a small turtle, likely a mud or musk turtle species, being held in human hands. The turtle has a high-domed, dark brown carapace with lighter orange/yellow margins on the scutes. Its skin is textured and greyish-brown, with prominent scales on the forelimbs. The head is large relative to the body, with a distinct eye and snout. The plastron (underside) appears yellowish-orange. The background consists of blurred human fingers and a dark blue garment.
